title: Canonical affine projections of a coherent formal module

from.place: affine projection comparison before the scalar annihilation argument

statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, F a coherent formal module for I, V an affine open, and n a natural number (level n+1). The canonical projection from the ModuleCat limit of the sections F_m(V) to F_n(V) is surjective, and its linear kernel equals I(V)^(n+1) times the whole limit module.

source.place: Lemma 087W, the canonical identification M/I^n M=M_n, restricted to an affine open; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: Restrict F to V. The restriction object theorem preserves the coherent formal system conditions. Identify the affine open scheme with Spec Γ(X,V), and its ideal with the ideal of sections.

Apply the affine theorem to obtain a limiting cone with surjective level projections and kernel I(V)^(n+1) times its vertex. Use the unique linear isomorphism of this cone with the canonical ModuleCat limiting cone. The projection equations transport surjectivity and the kernel formula; linear isomorphisms transport ideal multiples of the whole module.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_affine_projections
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) (V : X.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (limit.π (F.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) (op n)) ∧
    LinearMap.ker
      (limit.π (F.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) (op n)).hom =
      I.ideal V ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule Γ(X, V.1)
        (limit (F.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1)) :
          ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1)))
